dataPointType.description: Data point type for which normalized timeseries operation is being performed

includeFields.description: Fields on {@link NormalizedTimeseries} that need to be included. e.g. ['state', 'valid', 'values', 'gaps', 'counts']. If not set, then ALL the fields will be returned on the type

timeRange.description: Time range for which information needs to be retrieved for time dependent fields

includePreAggIntervals.description: ONLY for time range dependent columns. If set, will include data from pre-agg columns

onlyHotBuckets.description:
INTERNAL USE ONLY
If set, then only retrieves data for the hot buckets and does not embed data from cold. This could return a
NormalizedTimeseries object that does not comply with the range specified in the object

title: Indicates how to get normalized timeseries values
name: NormalizedTimeseriesGetSpec
